subject: planner: selectivity estimate not to go below 1 (#61045)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent; only production behavior change is in `pkg/planner/cardinality/selectivity.go`, which clamps the final selectivity so `selectivity * coll.RealtimeCount >= 1` (when `coll.RealtimeCount > 0`), gated by optimizer fix-control `47400` (allows old behavior when ON). Confirmed the function early-returns on `coll.RealtimeCount == 0` (`pkg/planner/cardinality/selectivity.go:72-74`), so the new `1.0/float64(coll.RealtimeCount)` cannot divide by zero. Checked a primary caller (`pkg/planner/core/stats.go:549-565`) which scales table stats by this selectivity, so the clamp achieves the intended “row estimate not below 1” there. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness/SQL semantics/session/txn/privilege/runtime handling; impact is limited to plan cost/row-count estimation and resulting plan choices/explain outputs. Later history check: `pkg/planner/cardinality/selectivity.go` is modified later on `upstream/master`, including removal of fix-control 47400 (`007466b089`), but no later commit indicates a correctness fix needed for this change.
